_comment: Ships committed with a placeholder competitor entry. Replace with real competitor names/URLs before relying on this — an empty or placeholder list means nothing meaningful gets monitored, not an error, so double-check this file actually reflects who you're tracking.

competitors.name: REPLACE_WITH_COMPETITOR_NAME
competitors._help: Pick pages that actually change when something worth knowing happens — homepage, pricing, and a product/features page are usually the highest-signal three. Monitoring every page on a competitor's site produces mostly noise (nav tweaks, blog post carousels) for the same review effort.

_note_on_ad_library_reaudit: This file only configures the deterministic site-diff script (site_snapshot.py). The periodic competitor AD-LIBRARY re-audit (Meta Ad Library / Google Ads Transparency Center) is a separate, LLM-driven path — see scheduled_prompt.md in this directory — because it needs WebFetch/WebSearch, which only a Claude session has, not a plain cron script.
